data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 595.8m at 1 Jan 2018. During 2018 there was a favourable movement in prior years' technical provisions of GBP 9.1m (a release of ~1.5% of opening gross reserves), attributed to favourable claims development across classes (notably Marine, Fire/property and Third party liability). The year also experienced significant current-year catastrophe activity (e.g. Hurricanes Florence and Michael and Californian wildfires) which impacted current year claims but the prior-year reserve run-off was positive overall.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior years' movement sourced from the 'Prior years' claims estimate' note (labelled as 'Favourable movement in technical provisions 9.1'). The table header references comparisons with net payments and provisions; the table entries used are taken as gross-class movements per the note layout but there is some ambiguity whether the presentation is gross or net - confidence set to 0.8. 'Miscellaneous' was mapped to 'Aggregate' for LOB movements (approximate). Claims development triangle values were read from scanned pages and some later-year cells are blank/null where not applicable.
